text: Elderly diabetic father, took morning insulin, but skip breakfast, then sweating, shakiness, dizziness, and confusion within one hour. Conscious swallowing. Denies vomiting and fever. No known drug allergy. Type two diabetes, on insulin and metformin. Hypoglycemia from mid midra me. Glucose 54 mg/ddL, rising to 72 after we drink. Plan fast sugar now. Recheck every 15 to 30 minutes. Hold extra insulin until review. Diet, never skip meals after insulin. Do race routine on on time of bedtime snack. Gentle fary sugar always. Monitor 24 hours. Resch for unconsciousness, seizure or repeat close. Followup in two days.
